note: Direct developers create a Meta app and a System User, then generate a permanent access token (bearer_token); Tech Providers serving other businesses use Business Integration System User tokens obtained via Embedded Signup (Facebook Login for Business, OAuth-like). Sign-up and test messaging are self-serve for your own account. Serving other businesses requires Business verification, App Review with video evidence and Tech Provider onboarding, hence the app_review blocker and the partner_gated reading. API is the Graph API (REST over HTTP) with webhooks; Meta also links an OpenAPI spec. No MCP page found in the WhatsApp docs I read; I did not search Meta's wider site. Per-message pricing page returned no extractable text, so cost terms are not confirmed. The URL developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp redirected to /documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/...
